Project.title: Project
Project.description: Client production and post-production project details, milestones, and deliverable links.

clientId.description: Firebase Auth UID or email of the client owner.

videoPreviewUrl.description: Main video URL for review and timestamped notes.

spatialVrUrl.description: Private 360 VR immersive embed or preview link.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.

RevisionNote.title: RevisionNote
RevisionNote.description: A timestamped change request or editorial note pinned to an exact video timecode.

timestampFormatted.description: Human readable timecode in MM:SS format.

note.description: Detailed revision request for the Loop Studios editorial team.

status.description: Current status of the revision note.

authorId.description: UID of the user who submitted the revision.

authorEmail.description: Email address of the note author.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the note was created.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Stores client deliverables, milestones, and metadata.

/projects/{projectId}/revision_notes/{no.description: Stores timestamped video revision feedback submitted by clients.
